title: Defensive stats
intro: The same measures, allowed by each defense. Lower EPA and success allowed is better. Pressure rate is pressures generated per opponent dropback; turnovers and sack rate are what the defense forced.

columns.label: Havoc rate
columns.note: Share of run and pass plays that end in a sack, tackle for loss, pass breakup, interception or lost fumble

columns.label: Havoc: sacks
columns.note: Share of run and pass plays; the four parts add up to the havoc rate (turnover first, then sack, tackle for loss, pass breakup)

columns.label: Havoc: tackles for loss
columns.note: Share of run and pass plays; the four parts add up to the havoc rate (turnover first, then sack, tackle for loss, pass breakup)

columns.label: Havoc: pass breakups
columns.note: Share of run and pass plays; the four parts add up to the havoc rate (turnover first, then sack, tackle for loss, pass breakup)
